name: Esar-haddon
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Sennacherib departs and dwells at Nineveh, and as he worships in the house of Nisroch his god, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer smite him with the sword and flee, and Esarhaddon his son reigns in his stead, fulfilling the word of verse 7.

note.label: 2 Kings 19: The Most High Defends Jerusalem

points: And we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin hear of the building and come to Zerubbabel asking to build with them, claiming to seek the same God since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur.

note.label: Ezra 4: The Adversaries Halt the Building

points: Esarhaddon his son reigns in his stead. The Most High's word stands from beginning to end.

note.label: Isaiah 37: Hezekiah's Prayer and the Overthrow of the Assyrians
